scripts.dev: npm run build -w @alunza/contracts && concurrently --kill-others -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @alunza/contracts" "npm run dev -w @alunza/api" "npm run dev -w @alunza/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @alunza/contracts && npm run build -w @alunza/runner && npm run build -w @alunza/ai && npm run build -w @alunza/api && npm run build -w @alunza/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @alunza/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --project tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts tests cypress.config.cjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests infra docs/work .github cypress.config.cjs package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.test: npm run openapi && npm run test -w @alunza/api && npm run test -w @alunza/web && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config tests/jest.contracts.cjs --runInBand && npm run test:runner && npm run test:ai && npm run test:preproduction
scripts.test:runner: npm run build -w @alunza/runner && npm run test -w @alunza/runner
scripts.test:ai: npm run build -w @alunza/contracts && npm run build -w @alunza/ai && npm run test -w @alunza/ai
scripts.test:ai:integration: npm run build -w @alunza/contracts && npm run build -w @alunza/ai && node scripts/ai-integration.mjs
scripts.ai:doctor: npm run build -w @alunza/contracts && npm run build -w @alunza/ai && node scripts/ai-probe.mjs --doctor
scripts.ai:probe: npm run build -w @alunza/contracts && npm run build -w @alunza/ai && node scripts/ai-probe.mjs
scripts.cypress:install: node node_modules/cypress/bin/cypress install && node node_modules/cypress/bin/cypress verify
